task.name: place_cube_pot_lid
task.description: Use the right arm to place the blue cube into the pot and then place the lid on top.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the blue cube.
3. Move the right arm to align with the pot.
4. Release the gripper to place the blue cube into the pot.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the lid.
7. Move the right arm to align with the pot.
8. Release the gripper to place the lid on top of the pot.
